issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) has inconsistent return types: the problem statement/UML specifies a return type of double (for double precision financial calculation), but the reference solution implements it as returning int. This mismatch can break compilation against tests/spec and confuses students about the required signature and precision.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution implementation signature to `public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and return a double (e.g., accumulate in a double or cast ingredient prices to double). Ensure any tests/expected API also use the double return type.
